notes.title: Update to version 1.0.1 (patch)
notes.content:
[h1]Complete changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed certain achievements and stats not updating correctly
[*]Fixed in-game music being too loud
[*]Made the text in how to play menu easier to read
[*]Centered the audio sliders and the text is also highlighted when selected
[*]Added a version text in options screen
[*]Removed some debugging tools
[/list]
